decision.explanation: The original sources provide direct and unambiguous statements supporting each of these positions. Document d1 (D1S2) states Andrea Dara has held the position of auxiliary bishop since 2015. Document d2 (D2S2) confirms Dara is a member of the Chamber of Deputies of the Italian Republic. Document d1 (D1S8) notes Dara served as Vicar General of the Diocese of Rome. These roles are distinct and non-conflicting, and the sources do not indicate any contradiction between them.
